_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Manual Organization Plan (TMOP)
summary: Describes the requirements for a Technical Manual Organization Plan that gives the Government a description of the overall technical manual development plan for a ship or major/complex system acquisition.
use_relationship:
The Technical Manual Organization Plan (TMOP) provides the Government program manager with a description of the overall TM development plan for a ship or major/complex system acquisition.  The TMOP is submitted to the Government for review and acceptance prior to the development of the TMs.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This data item shall not be procured when this information is provided by any other document.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TMOP shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The TMOP shall describe the general processes, procedures, terms, and conditions governing the planning, selection, preparation, and submission of TMs required for a ship or major/complex system acquisition.  The TMOP shall include a cover page which identifies the scope and applicability of the plan, including the following:

children.title: Name and address of contractor and contract number
The ship/system name covered by the plan
The Technical Manual Contract Requirement (TMCR) number covering development of the TMOP
Document Type Definition (DTD) Public Identifier(s) used to develop the TM(s) covered by the plan
Submittal date for the plan
The TMOP shall identify the scope of the TM program for the ship/system and equipment being acquired
children.content: This shall also include a summary of any assumptions, conditions, or limitations affecting TM development.

children.title: The TMOP shall identify the approach to satisfying the TM requirements of the contract and applicable TMCRs
children.content: The plan shall identify the types of TMs planned and needed for the ship/system and the preparing activity that will be developing each TM.  The plan shall also identify the intent to use non-developmental or Government-furnished manuals and commercial-off-the-shelf manuals.  The plan shall contain the scope, interfaces, and overlaps of the TMs planned for the ship/system.  The plan shall list the current applicable TMCRs to be used for development of the TMs cited in the plan as well as identify any additional TMCRs that will be required.  Anticipated tailoring of TMCR requirements shall be also identified.

children.title: The TMOP shall list the current applicable DTDs to be used for development of the TMs cited in the plan as well as identify any additional DTDs that will be required

The plan shall identify any intended use of special features, functionalities, or innovations planned for the TM program (e.g., software-driven diagnostics or maintenance data collection functionality within an IETM)
The TMOP shall include a proposed schedule to include the major steps required for progressive transition of the TM-data from the conceptual phase through definition phase to the acquisition phase
children.content: The schedule shall also include TM development, review, and delivery relative to acquisition milestones and other programmatic events (e.g., design schedules, ship delivery dates, equipment installation, initial training conduct, equipment production schedules).

children.title: The TMOP shall include a general description of TM product delivery and recordkeeping methods (e.g., integrated data environment, comment tracking database)
The TMOP shall identify the integration and coordination of TM development efforts between contractors and subcontractors
children.content: The plan shall also include an explanation of the methods to be used to affect standardization and data control for the TM program.  The plan shall identify methods for:

children.title: Achieving maximum standardization in writing style, artwork, nomenclature, abbreviations, symbols, etc., and reuse of data
Ensuring maximum use/reuse of design, manufacturing, and engineering drawings in TM development
Collection, control, and use of source data
children.content: Examples of source data elements include system maintenance plan, supportability analyses, and logistics management information.

children.title: TM configuration control, including tracking and incorporating data affecting one or multiple interrelated TMs

The TMOP shall specify development of supplements for technical information that will be published in hard copy format (e.g., large wiring diagrams, schematics, or classified material) needed to support fleet users, training commands, maintenance centers, and overhaul facilities
The TMOP shall specify the strategy for validation of contractor-developed TMs showing intent to comply with quality assurance requirements of the contract and applicable TMCRs
children.content: The plan shall also include specific reference to validation plans used in past contracts.

children.title: The TMOP shall identify the process that will be used to review and comment on verification plans prepared by the Government
children.content: The plan shall also identify any anticipated intent to support verification.

children.title: The TMOP shall identify the contractors' intent to resolve and incorporate validation, verification, and other review findings
